facts.fact: The Haut Commissariat a la Numerisation states its own services designed and developed the mechanism for verifying electronic documents issued through the Dzair Digital Services portal, which it trained sector information-system managers to deploy and operate.
facts.system: Electronic document verification mechanism (Dzair Digital Services portal)

note: Training session is not a fact; the HCN in-house development of the verification mechanism is. The document dates the session to the Thursday before 2026-09-19 (2026-09-17); no go-live date is stated, so no built fact.
